description: Rothco’s Enhanced Air Force Crew Bag offers durability and functionality, perfect for travel, gear storage, or daily use. Made from heavyweight nylon material, this bag is built to withstand the demands of travel while keeping your essentials safe and secure. The bag features a large 18 inch zippered opening, making it easy to pack and access your gear. With dual 16.75 inch carry handles, you can easily carry the bag by hand or throw it over your shoulder. The dual-zipper system ensures secure closure, while the spacious interior provides ample storage for clothes, equipment, or other necessities. Measuring approximately 17 inch x 11 inch x 10 inch, this storage bag is the ideal size for weekend trips, gym gear, or as a reliable everyday carry-all. Rothco’s Enhanced Air Force Crew Bag combines practicality with rugged design, making it a must-have for anyone needing a versatile and durable bag.
